description: We are StellarSpark, a creative team passionate about science, technology, and space exploration. For NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, we’re developing an interactive game where students manage a lunar or Martian outpost and learn the challenges of sustaining life beyond Earth.
summary:
Lost In Orbit is a 3D browser game by team StellarSpark, built for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 and designed for students aged 7-12. Players take the role of an astronaut sent to a Mars outpost after their ship loses contact in orbit. Through ten story-driven missions, they must keep the colony alive by managing power, water, oxygen, food, radiation safety and crew health.

Players walk the Martian surface in a white EVA suit, step through airlocks into habitats, eat and sleep, repair machines, and drive rovers. A full day-and-night cycle, dust storms and cold nights keep the challenge realistic. Four crew members, each with a unique perk, can be switched at any time.

Learning is built into play. Every mission is based on NASA data, including Mars facts, the MOXIE oxygen experiment, Mars dust research and the CHAPEA habitat simulation. Quizzes link to official NASA sources. Engineering decisions have real costs, so players learn that resources are never unlimited.

The game runs free in a desktop browser with no install. Independent student project; not an official NASA product.
details:
Lost In Orbit is an educational 3D browser-based survival simulation that teaches students aged 7–12 about the challenges of human exploration on Mars. Players are astronauts at a remote outpost who have lost contact with their spacecraft, and they must survive by managing oxygen, water, food, electricity, radiation protection, and crew health.

The game features ten story-driven missions, a day-and-night cycle, dust storms, cold nights, habitat exploration, airlock systems, rover driving, equipment maintenance, and four crew members with unique abilities.

Learning is tied to real NASA science, including oxygen production through the MOXIE experiment, astronaut isolation and health through CHAPEA research, and Martian dust storms, with quizzes linked to official NASA resources.

Built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Three.js, and Vite for desktop browsers, the game turns scientific concepts into interactive survival challenges where every decision has consequences. It encourages curiosity, critical thinking, problem-solving, and teamwork.

Lost In Orbit is an independent student project by Team StellarSpark for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, and is not an official NASA product.
